{{Quote|For your dining enjoyments, sirs, we offer, uh&hellip;''"<br />"''Mupple pies, sir.''"<br />"''&hellip;mupple pies.|Mungo Baobab and C-3PO|<ref name="droids" />}}
'''Mupple pies''' were a type of [[Pie/Legends|pie]] [[Merchant/Legends|sold]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]. In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mungo Baobab]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] [[Thief/Legends|stole]] some mupple pies from a pair of [[Unidentified alien merchants|aliens]] and used them to distract a pair of [[Security guard/Legends|security guards]] in the [[Fortress of Tawntoom]].

==Description==
{{Quote|They're free.|Mungo Baobab convinces the guards to eat pie|<ref name="droids" />}}
[[Mupple]] [[Pie/Legends|pies]] were a type of round [[Foodstuff/Legends|pie]]. The pies were [[Color/Legends|beige]] and [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. They were made from mupples,<ref name="droids" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roon/Legends|Roon]].<ref name="mupple">{{DroidsCite|Tail of the Roon Comets}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|More. More!|The guard demands more pie|<ref name="droids" />}}
[[File:GuardsEatingPie-TFC.png|thumb|left|280px|The guards enjoy some pie.]]
In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="date">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}} establishes that ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]'', which includes the appearance of [[mupple]] [[Pie/Legends|pies]] in "[[The Frozen Citadel]]," takes place fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> a pair of [[Unidentified alien merchants|alien merchants]] were [[Merchant/Legends|selling]] mupple pies on the planet Roon when another merchant, the Human [[Mungo Baobab]], and his [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], needed a disguise to get into the [[Fortress of Tawntoom]], the headquarters of local [[Governor/Legends|Governer]] [[Bisad Koong]]. After noticing the merchants, the pair bound them with [[Rope/Legends|rope]] and [[Thief/Legends|stole]] their [[Cloak/Legends|cloaks]] and pies, intending to pose as pie sellers. With the steaming pies in hand, Baobab and C-3PO went up to two [[Unidentified guard (Fortress of Tawntoom)|security]] [[Security guard/Legends|guards]] posted at the entrance, who forced them to halt. Baobab, at the suggestion of his [[Droid/Legends|droid]], offered pies for the guards to enjoy. The guards asked them to move forward, but Baobab needed a distraction, so he offered them each a pie at no [[Currency/Legends|cost]].<ref name="droids" />

The two guards accepted the new offer, enjoying the pies while C-3PO [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] in his shrunken droid counterpart, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who went to find [[Auren Yomm Baobab|Auren]] and [[Nilz Yomm]]&mdash;Baobab's friends who had been captured. Later, while waiting for R2-D2 to return, he began to worry that the pies' distraction would soon wear out. Indeed, just as the Yomms returned, the guards demanded more pie from Baobab and the droid. In order to again distract them, C-3PO pointed to the escaped [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], whom the security guards immediately ran after. However, the guards were quickly run down and apprehended by Baobab.<ref name="droids" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mupple pie appeared in "[[The Frozen Citadel]]," the thirteenth and final episode of the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] animated series,<ref name="droids" /> which aired on [[November 30]], [[1985]].<ref name="insider">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
